channel.title: Kicksecure 18.2.1.9 - Point Release!
channel.description:
# Download
https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Download
([What is a point release?](https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Point_Release))
----
# Upgrade
Alternatively, an in-place release upgrade is possible using the [Kicksecure repository](https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Project-APT-Repository).
----
This release would not have been possible without the numerous supporters of Kicksecure!
----
Please Donate!
https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Donate
----
Please Contribute!
https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Contribute
----
# Major Changes
* General: * Responsibly disclosed a number of security issues (CVEs) to upstream projects: https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Dev/research * introduced https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Vulnerability_Disclosure_Policy * Internal security review * GitHub Dependabot configuration * GitHub settings hardening * https://forums.kicksecure.com/t/port-to-sequoia-pgp-sq-gnupg-gpg-replacement-openpgp/260 * use https://forums.kicksecure.com/t/sequoia-git-sq-git/1638 * mitigate https://forums.kicksecure.com/t/executable-mime-handler-risks/1794 * Improved input sanitization and Unicode handling. * Add github native CI for builds (Thanks to @Mycobee!) * VirtualBox * work in progress fixing clipboard sharing host to VM and VM to host -> https://forums.whonix.org/t/how-to-enable-shared-clipboard-drag-and-drop-features-inside-virtualbox-with-whonix-lxqt-18-0-8-7/22588/99 * Replace virtualbox-guest-x11 and virtualbox-guest-utils with virtualbox-guest-additions-iso or a sufficiently new Oracle build of VirtualBox (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * new package uploaded to Kicksecure repository: virtualbox-guest-additions-iso (from Oracle) * VirtualBox sound setting: AC97 -> Intel HDA * https://forums.whonix.org/t/virtualbox-intel-hd-audio-and-pipewire-incompatibility-audio-broken-after-increasing-ram-to-5-gb-no-sound-after-latest-updates-pipewire-bug/18211/31 * CodeQL, and fuzzing: * helper-scripts (its python portion) * msgcollector (dito) * security-misc's file manager shim * anon-apt-sources-list: * Disable Debian Fast Track repository by default (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * apparmor-profile-torbrowser: * maintenance fixes * bindp: * Add more compiler hardening flags (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * bootclockrandomization: * Make startup on QubesOS require a NetVM (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * browser-choice: * Fix logic bug that prevented use in unrestricted admin mode (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * debug-misc: * sysctl: add cd-rom/dvd debugging settings (Thanks to @raja!) * desktop-config-dist: * Document rationale for GDK_BACKEND and QT_QPA_PLATFORM variables in 15_desktop-config-dist.sh (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Set labwc icon theme properly, use a non-Python logo for livecheck (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Adjust default terminal size to work better on small screens (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * dist-base-files: * Add account 'user' to group 'privleap' during initial installation (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * kicksecure-base-files: * Fix the default archiver application (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * kicksecure-meta-packages: * Stop including qps on LXQt systems by default (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Add dummy packages for more Secure Boot-related packages (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Remove dummy-dependency-fwupd-signed metapackage, because fwupd-signed is a virtual package (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Add dependency on mokutil, add additional dummy packages, split firmware-nonfreedom into arch-specific and arch-independent metapackages (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * fix: gpg-from-sq vs uwt * legacy-dist: * Use debug-kicksecure-enabled helper in fixes script (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Enable set -x when debug-kicksecure qvm-service is enabled (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Fix default archiver setting for existing users, fix a broken shellcheck include (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Mark qps for autoremoval (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Avoid error if dummy-dependency is not installed at upgrade time (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Comments, avoid error if xscreensaver is not installed at upgrade time (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * deprecate version 17 * Fix kloak failing to start after a Whonix-Workstation 17 release upgrade (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Fix release upgrade bug caused by usability-misc's policy-rc.d disappearing mid-upgrade (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * mediawiki-shell * major improvements and hardening * KVM: * Port to QEMU Session (Thanks to @HulaHoop!) * sdwdate: * Add more compiler hardening flags (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Fix sleep duration calculation (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Replace os.system() with subprocess.run() for safer URL handling (adapted from Claude Code) (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Make startup on QubesOS require a NetVM (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * sdwdate-gui: * Reliability improvements. * Make startup on QubesOS require a NetVM (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * security-misc: * D-Bus shim for org.freedesktop.FileManager1: fm-shim-frontend (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Prevent using systemd-journald to write text to other user's terminals (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * sysctl: add cd-rom/dvd hardening settings (Thanks to @raja!) * Add reference on IOMMU vulnerabilities (Thanks to @raja!) * Merge Meltdown mitigtions for ARM64 and X86_64 CPUs (Thanks to @raja!) * Reorder panic settings (Thanks to @raja!) * Add minor notices to panic on oopses and warnings (Thanks to @raja!) * Update docs on `proc_mem.force_override` (Thanks to @raja!) * Add KSPP partial compliance notice for `proc_mem.force_override=ptrace` (Thanks to @raja!) * serial-console-enable (opt-in package): * grub: set GRUB_TERMINAL=serial unconditionally * fix use of GRUB boot menu through serial console * sysmaint-panel: * Use sysmaint-panel's start menu icon as a window icon as well (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * systemcheck: * improved log analysis in `systemcheck --verbose` * Add CLI metapackages to check_packages.bsh (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Add test for if /etc, /var, and /usr are ephemeral in AppVMs (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * fix: do not report missing tirdad kernel module on non-Intel/AMD64 as error because it is expected and not actionable by users https://forums.whonix.org/t/often-systemcheck-errors-notifications-whonix-18lxqt/22900 https://www.kicksecure.com/wiki/Tirdad#Architecture_Support * Downgrade some network-related errors to warnings, don't exit prematurely if the qube has no NetVM (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Check previous boot's logs for critical messages (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * tb-updater: * sandbox, resume and security improvements * fixed ARM64 download link detection * tirdad: * Fix tirdad on kernel 6.12.94+ (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * tor-ctrl: * Harden against command injection (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * usability-misc: * `/etc/profile.d/30_path.sh`: prepend `/usr/local/sbin` `/usr/sbin` and `/sbin` to `PATH` environment variable No longer using zsh for that. No longer modify PATH in `/etc/zsh/zshenv`. Why `/sbin`? See: https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=1041357 https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=1041357#17 https://forums.kicksecure.com/t/path-overwritten-by-etc-zsh-zshrc/1677 https://github.com/assisted-by-ai/usability-misc/pull/5 * remove `/usr/share/safe-rm/bin` from `PATH` environment variable by default https://forums.kicksecure.com/t/path-overwritten-by-etc-zsh-zshrc/1677 * undo modprobe `options kvm enable_virt_at_load=0` https://forums.kicksecure.com/t/recent-versions-of-virtualbox-7-1-18-7-2-8-can-cause-a-system-crash-during-package-upgrades-vms-may-fail-to-start/1683 https://forums.kicksecure.com/t/vboxdrv-service-fails-to-start/1730 * fix: `/etc/profile.d/30_path.sh`: prepend `/usr/local/sbin` `/usr/sbin` and `/sbin` to `PATH` environment variable * user-sysmaint-split: * Add startup helper script and use labwc --startup. https://forums.kicksecure.com/t/system-maintenance-panel-not-showing-up/1603/17 (Thanks to eterniTTY!) * sysmaint-boot-unrestricted-qubes: improve reliability of unrestricted admin mode boot * `Wants=spice-vdagentd.socket` * https://forums.whonix.org/t/whonix-18-nitpicks/23255 * Harden against command injection (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Move the sysmaint locked password migration earlier to avoid spurious error messages caused by running autologinchange later (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Add account 'sysmaint' to group 'privleap' during initial installation (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * vm-config-dist: * https://forums.whonix.org/t/virtualbox-intel-hd-audio-and-pipewire-incompatibility-audio-broken-after-increasing-ram-to-5-gb-no-sound-after-latest-updates-pipewire-bug/18211 * fix: do not enable software rendering simply because `lvmpipe` is required. In case a known, hardcoded graphic card provider renderer string is detected, skip enabling software rendering. https://forums.kicksecure.com/t/kdenlive-monitor-issue-solved-by-ai-debian-13-kde-plasma-kicksecure-cli-hardened/1755 * Properly handle disabled displays in wlr-resize-watcher (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Restart wlr-resize-watcher when logging out and back in (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * Restart wlr-resize-watcher if it crashes (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!) * derivative-maker: * improved cross-build support * Apple `M#` Silicon (ARM64) build system improvements: VirtualBox operations were moved from the host into an `amd64` cowbuilder chroot, allowing ARM64 hosts such as Apple Silicon systems to produce VirtualBox images without requiring VirtualBox packages on the host. * developer-meta-files: * github-org-clone: Bulk-clones repositories from an GitHub organization into a local directory. * github-org-fork: Bulk-forks a GitHub organization. * github-org-push: Bulk-push. * dm-github-fork-sync: * dm-github-org-policy: Applies and audits organization-wide GitHub security and governance policy. * dm-github-personal-policy: Applies equivalent policy controls to personally owned repositories. * dm-github-org-metadata-sync: Synchronizes repository descriptions, homepages, and topics from a central metadata file. * dm-github-org-security-report: Produces a Markdown report on repository and organization security settings or gaps. * dm-github-token-test: Checks whether a GitHub token is present, safely stored, and has the expected access. * Reusable GitHub workflows: * Scorecard (investigated, checkup using OpenSSF supply-chain security checker completed) * Harden GitHub workflows * unicode and control character resistant git review tools * Cleanup: * deprecate ro-mode-init (initramfs-only) (ported to dracut) * deprecate gpg-bash-lib (port to sq)
----
# Full difference of all changes
[https://github.com/Kicksecure/derivative-maker/compare/18.1.4.2-developers-only...18.2.1.0-developers-only](https://github.com/Kicksecure/derivative-maker/compare/18.1.4.2-developers-only...18.2.1.0-developers-only)
----
(This forum post was previously a call for testers. No release critical bugs where found during the testing period. This forum post was therefore [transformed](https://forums.whonix.org/t/transform-whonix-testers-wanted-forum-news-post-into-whonix-release-forum-news-post-ok/11405) into a stable release announcement. See edit history.)

item.title: Kicksecure 18.2.1.9 - Point Release!
item.dc:creator: Patrick
item.description:
Download

Kicksecure – 25 Dec 25

Download Kicksecure (FREE)

FREE download of Kicksecure. Kicksecure can be installed on a physical machine as the host operating system (OS), as a guest OS inside a virtual machine, or as a portable host OS on a USB data stick.

(What is a point release?)

Upgrade

Alternatively, an in-place release upgrade is possible using the Kicksecure repository.

This release would not have been possible without the numerous supporters of Kicksecure!

Please Donate!

Kicksecure – 25 Dec 25

Donating to Kicksecure

PayPal, Bitcoin (BTC), Monero (XMR), Ethereum (ETH) or Token, Credit Card, Bank Wire, Others

Please Contribute!

Kicksecure – 29 Apr 26

Contribute to Kicksecure

Spread, Follow, Develop, Testing, Donate. Contribute to Freedom Software / Open Source.

Major Changes

  • General:
    • Responsibly disclosed a number of security issues (CVEs) to upstream projects: Security Research by Kicksecure
    • introduced Kicksecure Vulnerability Disclosure Policy
    • Internal security review
    • GitHub Dependabot configuration
    • GitHub settings hardening
    • Port to Sequoia-PGP ("sq") (GnuPG ("gpg") replacement) - OpenPGP
    • use Sequoia git (`sq-git`)
    • mitigate Executable MIME handler risks
    • Improved input sanitization and Unicode handling.
    • Add github native CI for builds (Thanks to @Mycobee!)
  • VirtualBox
    • work in progress fixing clipboard sharing host to VM and VM to host → How to enable Shared Clipboard & Drag-and-Drop features inside VirtualBox with Whonix-LXQt-18.0.8.7 ? - #99 by Patrick - VirtualBox - Whonix Forum
    • Replace virtualbox-guest-x11 and virtualbox-guest-utils with virtualbox-guest-additions-iso or a sufficiently new Oracle build of VirtualBox (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • new package uploaded to Kicksecure repository: virtualbox-guest-additions-iso (from Oracle)
    • VirtualBox sound setting: AC97 → Intel HDA
      • VirtualBox Intel HD Audio and PipeWire Incompatibility / Audio broken after increasing ram to 5 GB / No sound after latest updates - PipeWire Bug? - #31 by sxd - VirtualBox - Whonix Forum
  • CodeQL, and fuzzing:
    • helper-scripts (its python portion)
    • msgcollector (dito)
    • security-misc’s file manager shim
  • anon-apt-sources-list:
    • Disable Debian Fast Track repository by default (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • apparmor-profile-torbrowser:
    • maintenance fixes
  • bindp:
    • Add more compiler hardening flags (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • bootclockrandomization:
    • Make startup on QubesOS require a NetVM (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • browser-choice:
    • Fix logic bug that prevented use in unrestricted admin mode (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • debug-misc:
    • sysctl: add cd-rom/dvd debugging settings (Thanks to @raja!)
  • desktop-config-dist:
    • Document rationale for GDK_BACKEND and QT_QPA_PLATFORM variables in 15_desktop-config-dist.sh (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Set labwc icon theme properly, use a non-Python logo for livecheck (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Adjust default terminal size to work better on small screens (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • dist-base-files:
    • Add account ‘user’ to group ‘privleap’ during initial installation (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • kicksecure-base-files:
    • Fix the default archiver application (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • kicksecure-meta-packages:
    • Stop including qps on LXQt systems by default (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Add dummy packages for more Secure Boot-related packages (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Remove dummy-dependency-fwupd-signed metapackage, because fwupd-signed is a virtual package (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Add dependency on mokutil, add additional dummy packages, split firmware-nonfreedom into arch-specific and arch-independent metapackages (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • fix: gpg-from-sq vs uwt
  • legacy-dist:
    • Use debug-kicksecure-enabled helper in fixes script (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Enable set -x when debug-kicksecure qvm-service is enabled (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Fix default archiver setting for existing users, fix a broken shellcheck include (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Mark qps for autoremoval (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Avoid error if dummy-dependency is not installed at upgrade time (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Comments, avoid error if xscreensaver is not installed at upgrade time (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • deprecate version 17
    • Fix kloak failing to start after a Whonix-Workstation 17 release upgrade (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Fix release upgrade bug caused by usability-misc’s policy-rc.d disappearing mid-upgrade (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • mediawiki-shell
    • major improvements and hardening
  • KVM:
    • Port to QEMU Session (Thanks to @HulaHoop!)
  • sdwdate:
    • Add more compiler hardening flags (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Fix sleep duration calculation (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Replace os.system() with subprocess.run() for safer URL handling (adapted from Claude Code) (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Make startup on QubesOS require a NetVM (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • sdwdate-gui:
    • Reliability improvements.
    • Make startup on QubesOS require a NetVM (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • security-misc:
    • D-Bus shim for org.freedesktop.FileManager1: fm-shim-frontend (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Prevent using systemd-journald to write text to other user’s terminals (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • sysctl: add cd-rom/dvd hardening settings (Thanks to @raja!)
    • Add reference on IOMMU vulnerabilities (Thanks to @raja!)
    • Merge Meltdown mitigtions for ARM64 and X86_64 CPUs (Thanks to @raja!)
    • Reorder panic settings (Thanks to @raja!)
    • Add minor notices to panic on oopses and warnings (Thanks to @raja!)
    • Update docs on proc_mem.force_override (Thanks to @raja!)
    • Add KSPP partial compliance notice for proc_mem.force_override=ptrace (Thanks to @raja!)
  • serial-console-enable (opt-in package):
    • grub: set GRUB_TERMINAL=serial unconditionally
    • fix use of GRUB boot menu through serial console
  • sysmaint-panel:
    • Use sysmaint-panel’s start menu icon as a window icon as well (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • systemcheck:
    • improved log analysis in systemcheck --verbose
    • Add CLI metapackages to check_packages.bsh (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Add test for if /etc, /var, and /usr are ephemeral in AppVMs (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • fix: do not report missing tirdad kernel module on non-Intel/AMD64 as error because it is expected and not actionable by users Often systemcheck errors notifications. whonix 18lxqt - Unsupported Platforms - Whonix Forum tirdad - TCP ISN CPU Information Leak Protection
    • Downgrade some network-related errors to warnings, don’t exit prematurely if the qube has no NetVM (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Check previous boot’s logs for critical messages (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • tb-updater:
    • sandbox, resume and security improvements
    • fixed ARM64 download link detection
  • tirdad:
    • Fix tirdad on kernel 6.12.94+ (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • tor-ctrl:
    • Harden against command injection (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • usability-misc:
    • /etc/profile.d/30_path.sh: prepend /usr/local/sbin /usr/sbin and /sbin to PATH environment variable No longer using zsh for that. No longer modify PATH in /etc/zsh/zshenv. Why /sbin? See: I Challenge Thee I Challenge Thee PATH overwritten by /etc/zsh/zshrc zsh: consolidate PATH setup in zshenv by assisted-by-ai · Pull Request #5 · assisted-by-ai/usability-misc · GitHub
    • remove /usr/share/safe-rm/bin from PATH environment variable by default PATH overwritten by /etc/zsh/zshrc
    • undo modprobe options kvm enable_virt_at_load=0 Recent versions of VirtualBox (7.1.18, 7.2.8) can cause a system crash during package upgrades, VMs may fail to start Vboxdrv.service fails to start
    • fix: /etc/profile.d/30_path.sh: prepend /usr/local/sbin /usr/sbin and /sbin to PATH environment variable
  • user-sysmaint-split:
    • Add startup helper script and use labwc --startup. System Maintenance Panel not showing up - #17 by eternity (Thanks to eterniTTY!)
    • sysmaint-boot-unrestricted-qubes: improve reliability of unrestricted admin mode boot
    • Wants=spice-vdagentd.socket
      • Sysmaint and its removal broken - Development - Whonix Forum
    • Harden against command injection (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Move the sysmaint locked password migration earlier to avoid spurious error messages caused by running autologinchange later (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Add account ‘sysmaint’ to group ‘privleap’ during initial installation (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • vm-config-dist:
    • VirtualBox Intel HD Audio and PipeWire Incompatibility / Audio broken after increasing ram to 5 GB / No sound after latest updates - PipeWire Bug? - VirtualBox - Whonix Forum
    • fix: do not enable software rendering simply because lvmpipe is required. In case a known, hardcoded graphic card provider renderer string is detected, skip enabling software rendering. Kdenlive monitor issue solved by AI - Debian 13 KDE Plasma _ Kicksecure.cli Hardened
    • Properly handle disabled displays in wlr-resize-watcher (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Restart wlr-resize-watcher when logging out and back in (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
    • Restart wlr-resize-watcher if it crashes (Thanks to @ArrayBolt3!)
  • derivative-maker:
    • improved cross-build support
    • Apple M# Silicon (ARM64) build system improvements: VirtualBox operations were moved from the host into an amd64 cowbuilder chroot, allowing ARM64 hosts such as Apple Silicon systems to produce VirtualBox images without requiring VirtualBox packages on the host.
  • developer-meta-files:
    • github-org-clone: Bulk-clones repositories from an GitHub organization into a local directory.
    • github-org-fork: Bulk-forks a GitHub organization.
    • github-org-push: Bulk-push.
    • dm-github-fork-sync:
    • dm-github-org-policy: Applies and audits organization-wide GitHub security and governance policy.
    • dm-github-personal-policy: Applies equivalent policy controls to personally owned repositories.
    • dm-github-org-metadata-sync: Synchronizes repository descriptions, homepages, and topics from a central metadata file.
    • dm-github-org-security-report: Produces a Markdown report on repository and organization security settings or gaps.
    • dm-github-token-test: Checks whether a GitHub token is present, safely stored, and has the expected access.
    • Reusable GitHub workflows:
    • Scorecard (investigated, checkup using OpenSSF supply-chain security checker completed)
    • Harden GitHub workflows
    • unicode and control character resistant git review tools
  • Cleanup:
    • deprecate ro-mode-init (initramfs-only) (ported to dracut)
    • deprecate gpg-bash-lib (port to sq)

Full difference of all changes

https://github.com/Kicksecure/derivative-maker/compare/18.1.4.2-developers-only…18.2.1.0-developers-only

(This forum post was previously a call for testers. No release critical bugs where found during the testing period. This forum post was therefore transformed into a stable release announcement. See edit history.)
